_about: RR-408 A5: the same university listed twice under two slugs. Each 'from' slug answers 308 to 'to' (next.config.ts) and leaves the pages, the sitemap and the search; its row stays in universities-publishable.json untouched (deactivate, never delete). A pair is merged only when both rows are in one country and one city AND share the official website (or one row has none). Generated by the RR-408 classifier from the title-clash groups; different cities or websites are kept as separate institutions.
